passes.title: Bug review: pixel-level scoring defect found in dilcond.py and fixed
passes.summary: Added tests/test_dilcond.py (6 unit tests). One test (zero-signal pixels must stay at exact zero, not an average-rank tie) failed against the pass-8 implementation: the log-sum-exp-with-epsilon combination across scales left a shared non-zero floor for pixels that were non-anomalous at every scale, which percentile-rank then spread to the middle of the score distribution instead of zero, contradicting the frozen spec. Fixed by replacing the combination with a direct product + exact n-th root (exact zero propagates). This is a bug fix to match the already-frozen spec, applied before interpreting results (the pre-fix run had already failed the same gate, so there was no incentive to rescue it). Rebuilt the label-free feature and reran the full holdout from scratch with the corrected code; both the feature artifact and OOF TIFF changed SHA256 as expected. The corrected result (dense 0.137279 / sparse 0.077035, 4/4 confirmation wins vs raw, still short of the +0.005 gate) supersedes the pre-fix numbers (dense 0.133808 / sparse 0.075398, 3/4 wins), which are documented but not cited as operative.
